semantic_content.answer: Let S_n=1+3+\cdots+(2n-1). For n=1, S_1=1=1^2. If S_n=n^2, then S_{n+1}=S_n+(2(n+1)-1)=n^2+2n+1=(n+1)^2. Hence, by induction, S_n=n^2 for every positive integer n.
